award.description: Prize, list or syllabus name, or part of it, e.g. "Booker Prize", "Pulitzer", "Nobel", "Hugo", "AQA". When one source's name matches exactly, only that source is returned.

category.description: Only winners, only the shortlist, or only the longlist

source_type.description: Only prizes ("award"), only canonical lists and publisher series ("list"), or only school curricula and exam boards ("curriculum"). Leave it out for prizes and lists together, without curricula.

name: get_award_winners

awards.description: Award results grouped by year, most recent first

award_kind.description: "curriculum" for a school syllabus or exam board, "publisher_series" or "list"; null for prizes and the older lists

award_type.description: "award" for a prize, "canonical_list" for a list, publisher series or curriculum

category.description: Recognition status, e.g. winner or shortlist

filters_applied.description: Echo of the filters used (award, year_min, year_max, category, source_type); only set filters appear

truncated.description: True when more matching recognitions exist than were returned; narrow the year range or raise the limit to see more

title: Browse award winners
